kev_metadata.shortDescription: The Graphics Device Interface (GDI) in Microsoft Windows Vista SP2; Windows Server 2008 SP2 and R2 SP1; Windows 7 SP1; Windows 8.1; Windows Server 2012 Gold and R2; Windows RT 8.1; and Windows 10 Gold, 1511, and 1607 allows local users to gain privileges

title: TIBCO JasperReports Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX vGPU contains an improper input validation vulnerability due to the host server failing to properly validate input from an authenticated user on a guest operating system. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution on the host operating system.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX vGPU Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX vGPU Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS CoreGraphics contain an integer overflow vulnerability which may allow code execution when processing a maliciously crafted PDF. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of FORCEDENTRY.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability

title: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR841N contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default, leading to the disclose of stored credentials. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link TL-WR841N Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page.
